home.pageDescriptionSEO: Welcome to Weil & Associés: Discover our expert legal approach and commitment to excellence and innovation. Visit our site to learn more.
home.heroSubtitle: A firm of excellence dedicated to international companies
home.home1: Weil & Associés is a law firm dedicated to the service of international companies since 1974.<nl/>Our firm is dedicated to assisting international companies,  small and medium-sized, in their commercial or industrial activities in France or abroad through proactive legal advice as well as by the defense of our clients before the courts and arbitral tribunals.<nl/>We think <blue>Further</blue>, we work <blue>Smarter</blue> and we act <blue>Swiftly</blue>. <nl/> We represent & advise clients on a domestic and international level from corporate and commercial transactions including mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, technology transfers, litigation & arbitration, White collar crime, employment and labor law, to corporate governance & law. Our team of about twenty people, focuses exclusively on your business needs to bring you excellent services & solutions in a more efficient & sustainable way.
home.home2: Our firm is a member of an international network of law firms sharing its culture of excellence and efficiency. Our lawyers are also admitted to practice before foreign bars, including Germany or the New York Bar in the United States. <nl/>In addition to French and English, the team also works in German, making the firm a high-level partner with expertise in cross-border business relations between France and Germany.

expertise.metaDescription: Discover our expertise in {{title}} at Weil & Associés.
expertise.pageDescriptionSEO: Explore our areas of expertise at Weil & Associés. Our team provides specialized legal solutions across various sectors to meet your needs.
expertise.ourGoal: <blue>Our goal is very simple:</blue>To provide companies, individuals and entrepreneurs with tailor-made, high-level services to solve their problems. That's why we always strive to go further, work smarter and act quickly in your best interests and <blue>with the utmost attention to detail</blue>.

expertiseList.title: Labor Law & Restructuring
expertiseList.intro: <blue>Weil & Associés</blue> has been supporting its clients since 1974 in the context of various social law issues, in advice and litigation.
expertiseList.paragraph1: We assist HR managers of multinational groups in complex and sensitive cross-border restructuring operations, in particular workforce reductions, site closures or company transfers.We intervene also in areas such as the integration of codes of good conduct and internal regulations, the negotiation of collective agreements on participation, profit-sharing or flexible working time, discrimination, termination of employment contracts and individual disputes or Our Firm Finally, for more than twenty years, has been advising the employer side in the context of the annual negotiation of a sectoral collective agreement.For any questions relating to subjects of interest in the field of labor law, you can contact our partners directly Mathilde WEIL and Eric WEIL.

expertiseList.title: Mergers & Acquisitions
expertiseList.intro: <blue>Weil & Associés</blue> is regularly involved in Mergers & Acquisitions. We support our clients, whether French or foreign companies, in all phases of a transaction, from the legal audit, the preparation and organization of data rooms, the development of strategies specific to each case, the conduct of negotiations through to the completion of the project.
expertiseList.paragraph1: We support our clients, French or foreign companies, in all phases of an operation, from the legal audit, the preparation and organization of data rooms, the development of a strategy specific to each file, the conduct of negotiations until Our perfect command of German and English, in addition to French, allows us to advise our clients and draft all legal documents and contracts in these three languages.The multidisciplinary nature of the Firm allows us to quickly mobilize our various specialists, in order to quickly provide our clients with all the answers to the legal issues that may arise during an operation.Post-transaction legal support: Once the transaction has been completed, we offer our clients regular legal support and supervise the consequences of such an operation in all areas (implementation of representations and warranties agreements, transfer of employment contracts, setting-up of internal reorganization measures and handling of the resulting social consequences, litigation support, etc.)Recent transactions of our M&A team:Acquisition by a leading German logistics group of two French companies specializing in logistics and freight transport.Acquisition by a Swedish group of several companies specializing in the distribution of industrial hoses and tubes for flexible fittings and fluid distribution systems.Acquisition by the European leader in TV metadata of a TV program publishing company, sold by the French Lagardère group;Sale of a concrete pillar manufacturing plant in northern France to a German construction company;Sale of a private school (under British curriculum) on the Côte d'Azur to one of Europe's leading players in educational services;Acquisition by a German group of several French companies specializing in the production and distribution of equipment for public and private swimming pools;Acquisition by a German group of a group of companies specializing in the production of paper and corrugated board products.Acquisition by a Chinese group listed in Hong Kong and specializing in power tools, of a French company specializing in the sale of portable tools.Takeover by a French telecommunications company of a telecommunications engineering and technical studies business as part of a receivership procedure.Acquisition by a German group of French maintenance companies in the nuclear sector.Acquisition by an American group of French companies specializing in cloud computing.Sale of pharmaceutical business and goodwill.For any questions on topics of interest in the fields of Mergers & Acquisitions and Private Equity, you can contact our partners directly Patricia VINCENT or Eric WEIL.

expertiseList.title: Corporate & Compliance
expertiseList.intro: <blue>Weil & Associés</blue> is renowned for both its advisory and litigation work in corporate law.
expertiseList.paragraph1: From their incorporation to their striking-off, our team provides legal support to all types of companies, commercial and civil, whether in the context of routine operations (such as shareholders meetings, boards meetings, approval of financial statements, appointment or renewal of corporate officers, etc….) or more complex matters (such as mergers, spin outs, partial contribution of assets, equity restructuring, setting up of governance and compliance structures and procedures).Weil & Associés is responsible for the corporate legal paperwork of hundreds of companies of any size, especially belonging to international groups of companies.In addition to advisory services, Weil & Associés assists and represents clients in all corporate law litigation matters (shareholder disputes, disputes with directors and corporate officers, management liability, etc.).For any questions relating to matters relating to company law, you can contact our partner directly. Patricia VINCENT.

expertiseList.title: Litigation, Mediation & International Arbitration
expertiseList.intro: Whether it concerns classic litigation or complex procedures with strategic issues before state or arbitral courts, Weil
expertiseList.paragraph1: In this role, transparency towards the client is a determining element to avoid any unexpected or unforeseen results. The first step For us, it always consists of an in-depth analysis of the file in order to propose the strategy financially best suited to the challenges of each file, based on our assessment of the solidity of the file.With experience of internal and international litigation since 1974, our Firm is equipped with solid reflexes which allow it to appeal to lines of argument using the subtleties of the procedure, sometimes making it possible to put an end to a case without even having to address the merits In some cases more media, we have experience of using the media as an additional weapon in the management of the procedure.Finally, we never forget, and at all stages of the procedure, that our clients' business is not to litigate and that litigation always constitutes a source of internal nuisance.For any questions on topics related to Litigation, Mediation & International Arbitration, you can directly contact our partner Eric WEIL.

expertiseList.title: Insolvency proceedings
expertiseList.intro: At <blue>Weil & Associés</blue>, we accompany investors or shareholders as well as the management of companies in difficulty through the stages giving access to the settlement of liabilities and the reversal of their company's obese situation
expertiseList.paragraph1: The reactivity and experience in insolvency law are key factors in the success of these operations.Our Firm is equipped with a long experience in these areas, allowing us to appreciate the most appropriate options offered by the law for companies in difficulty.For any questions on topics of interest in the fields of Mergers & Acquisitions and Private Equity, you can directly contact our partners Patricia VINCENT and Eric WEIL.

expertiseList.title: Commercial, Competition & Consumer Law
expertiseList.intro: <blue>Weil & Associés</blue> operates in all areas of commercial, consumer and competition law, both upstream to advise our clients on the best strategy for distributing,  developing and regulating their products and/or services, and downstream to assist them in the event of inspections by the competition authorities.
expertiseList.paragraph1: We are particularly involved in :commercial negotiating, pricing transparency and restrictive practicesexclusive distribution and selective distributionconsumer law, advertisementcompetition law, cartels, abuse of dominant position and abuse of economic dependencelegal procedures common before civil and criminal courtsDGCCRF investigations and procedures before the Competition Authority and community authorities.Some recent significant missions:assistance of a leading company in the context of the analysis of anti-competitive practices in the postal marketassistance and representation before the French and European courts of a manufacturer of consumer productsadvice for the development of a selective distribution network in the luxury sector, drafting of contracts and General Conditions of Salereview advertising campaigns and promotional operations for the marketing of electrical hand tools sold in DIY supermarketsreview labeling of garbage bags and food films sold in general supermarketsexam range discount agreements for several major players in the pharmaceutical sectorelaboration regulatory compliance programs for several players in the automotive sectorassistance and representation of a leading pharmaceutical player in the context of the anti-gift law.If you have any questions about commercial, consumer and competition law, please contact our partner Bruno Weil, who is responsible for these areas.

expertiseList.title: IP/IT, Digital, Tech & Data Law
expertiseList.intro: <blue>Weil & Associés</blue>, is deeply committed to representing its clients on a multitude of matters related to the many facets of <blue>intellectual property</blue> and <blue>new technologies, Tech & Data</blue> law.<nl/>Our team of experts is dedicated to providing innovative and customized legal solutions tailored to the unique and ever-changing challenges of these fields.
expertiseList.paragraph1: Here are some recent examples:General industrial property law: we support our clients during company sale or buyout operations, either by preparing the PI/IT part of the dataroom or by carrying out the legal audit during the due diligence phase; Copyright: we represent our clients in infringement proceedings before French courts, e.g. Patent law: we represent our clients during the preparatory phase (planning and execution of counterfeit seizures on French territory) and during counterfeiting and unfair competition trials before the French courts, for example on request. New technologies and IT law: we regularly intervene before courts or specialized arbitration courts for our clients in cases of domain name piracy, e.g. For any questions related to these topics, please contact directly our partner Bruno WEIL who is responsible for these areas.

expertiseList.title: White collar crime
expertiseList.intro: <blue>Weil & Associés</blue> specializes in the efficient and expert management of criminal business law cases for its clients, leveraging recognized expertise and a personalized approach to meet each client's specific needs.
expertiseList.paragraph1: We intervene upstream to advise our clients on the strategy to adopt when risky situations arise, for example for any offense linked to economic law or product regulation, or when offenses have been committed by employees or corporate officers. Knowing our clients' activities well, our lawyers are able to assist them effectively, particularly in terms of:Offenses “President fraud” type financial transactionsOffenses in the context of competition law, agreements, abuse of dominant position and abuse of economic dependenceInvestigations of the DGCCRF and common law procedures before the criminal courtsCriminal Law workAbuse of corporate assets, breach of trust, passive and active corruption.For any questions relating to matters relating to business criminal law, you can contact our partner directly. Eric WEIL.

partenaire.pageDescriptionSEO: Meet the partners of Weil & Associés, a team of legal experts dedicated to providing innovative and tailored solutions to our clients.
partenaire.teamPresentation: Our firm is made up of four experienced partners with <blue>over 100 years' combined professional experience</blue>. Each of them is fluent in English and German, and has an international legal profile and background. In addition to their specialist areas of expertise, <blue>each of our partners has a broad knowledge of business law</blue>, covering between them the full range of our clients' <blue>activities and needs</blue>.<nl/>You will find below an individual presentation of each partner. We also have a team of senior parteners and lawyers, all of whom have legal training or international experience.

brunoWeil.title: Avocat (1999)
brunoWeil.name: Bruno WEIL
brunoWeil.intro: Active for twenty-five years as a lawyer for international companies of all sizes, present or active in France, Bruno Weil is your privileged contact within our firm for all questions relating to intellectual and industrial property, digital law, tech and data, as well as issues arising from the use of artificial intelligence. In this capacity, he acts as counsel and advocate before the courts in all types of contentious cases. In his capacity as counsel, he has successfully represented several US and German multinationals, both listed on the stock exchange and privately-owned, before the French courts, notably in complex patent, trademark and copyright infringement cases, as well as unfair competition litigation.<nl/>A former French correspondent for the publisher KLUWER LAW INTERNATIONAL, Bruno is also a member of several international associations dealing with intellectual property and new technologies, such as Licensing Executive Society - LES - Germany, GRUR and ITECHLAW. Bruno has published several articles on current topics in these fields.<nl/>Bruno Weil is also active in other areas of law, such as corporate restructuring and takeovers, product regulation and shareholder disputes. His day-to-day practice also involves all types of business-related advice and/or litigation. His main aim is to successfully devise the most effective business strategy to ensure that our clients' interests prevail.<nl/>In addition to French, Bruno is fluent in German and English.

ericWeil.title: Avocat (1996), Rechtsanwalt (1999), Attorney at Law (2002)
ericWeil.name: Eric WEIL
ericWeil.intro: Eric’s areas of practice are employment law, complex litigation, international arbitration, mergers and acquisitions and white-collar crime litigation.<nl/>Eric is highly recognized for his extensive experience in M&A, restructuring plan negotiations, multiparty employment litigation, complex commercial litigation of national and international importance. Having handled high-profiled, complex litigation matters on behalf of large global corporations, Eric offers quality and reactivity across a wide array of disputes. Eric’s comprehensive service, track record, tailor-made approach makes him a go to choose for companies faced with complex strategical issues. Eric also has extensive experience in white collar crime involving a wide variety of cases such as deceptive labeling of pharmaceutical products, misappropriation of trade secrets, forgery, misuse of corporate assets, hindrance to the rights of employees’ representatives or discrimination.<nl/>Eric also regularly advices and counsels his clients on sensitive internal fraud investigations. Eric’s top trial skills are also key for international arbitration: enhanced knowledge of international arbitration law and procedure, expertise across a broad range of industries and substantive areas of law and the ability to work fluently in English, French and German. The combination of skills, expertise, and experience, together with a multi-cultural approach, has enabled his team to obtain outstanding results for our clients.<nl/>Always bearing in mind his clients’ business objectives and economic goals, Eric is praised as a collaborative partner who offers high-level guidance in mergers and acquisitions, be it at a national level or cross-border. His background as both litigator and employment law specialist makes him a key player not only at the due diligence stage to spot potential risks, but more importantly at the negotiation level, when negotiating the specifics of the purchase agreement. When faced with the sensitive issues frequently surrounding employment matters, companies look to Eric for his experience in providing sophisticated and practical advice, including designing a negotiation strategy with worker’s representatives and Unions. Eric’s multidisciplinary approach enables him to offer creative advice taking into account all aspects of a given situation. Eric has dealt with the full spectrum of employment issues, such as large scale reductions in force, executive compensation, severance and employment agreements, restrictive covenants and trade secret litigation as well as issues arising from mergers, acquisitions, corporate restructuring and bankruptcies.<nl/>Over the past three decades, Eric has advised public and private companies in various sectors, including chemicals, automotive industry, luxury goods, pharmaceutical products, construction, banking sector, aviation and military weapons, tobacco industry, internet and new technologies, or logistics. Lastly, Eric takes a limited amount of bro bono criminal and domestic violence matters to assist and represent the victim in matters where the client is not speaking French and not in a financial position to hire a lawyer.<nl/>Eric is fully qualified to practice in France, Germany and the U.S.A. (state of New York) and has the ability not only to work fluently in all three languages but also to embrace, understand and weight all specific cultural aspects that make each case unique, and is therefore highly valued as lead counsel on complex cross-border issues.

patriciaVincent.title: Avocat (2005)
patriciaVincent.name: Patricia VINCENT
patriciaVincent.intro: Patricia is your primary contact for all matters dealing with corporate law. Together with our team, she advises and assists our clients, French or international corporate groups, in all legal matters, whether current operations (formation of companies, annual general meetings, appointment or dismissal of managers, directors and other corporate officers, etc….) or more complex matters and in particular restructuring of companies (mergers, spin outs, partial contribution of capital, restructuring of the share capital or liquidation of companies).<nl/>Patricia is also active in all M&A transactions, private equity, sales or purchases of companies or businesses. She has gained a strong experience in this field and is involved in all stages of the operation, from the legal due diligence, the strategic considerations based on the issues deriving out of each individual case, the conduct of the negotiations to the finalization of the agreements and finally the dealing with post transactional issues.<nl/>Her activities have brought her to finalize transactions for small and medium-sized corporations as well as multinational companies, whether in French, English or German, that she speaks and writes fluently.<nl/>Besides corporate law and mergers and acquisitions (M&A), she also dedicates a part of her activities to employment, commercial, insurance and social protection law, both in the field of counselling and litigation.<nl/>Patricia is member of several M&A and international bar associations.

mathildeHouetWeil.title: Avocat (1996), Attorney at Law (2002)
mathildeHouetWeil.name: Mathilde HOUET WEIL
mathildeHouetWeil.intro: After several years of practice with major international law firms, Mathilde Houet-Weil joined Weil & Associés in 2003 to lead and develop the firm’s labor and employment law department.<nl/>Mathilde has over 25 years of experience representing English and German-speaking clients in a broad range of employment and labor-related litigation matters, both in counsel and litigation. She regularly counsels HR managers of global companies on their most important and sensitive labor and employment issues. She has extensive experience advising employers with respect to reorganizations (downsizing, closing of plants, business transfers, international and national mobility) as well as corporate policies, employment discrimination, whistleblower claims, breach of contract and wrongful termination claims, internal investigations, or mandatory working hours. Mathilde represents clients in labour courts, civil courts, criminal courts and administrative courts.<nl/>Mathilde’s clients come from all sectors of the global economy, including the automotive, pharmaceutical, chemical, mining, advertising, e-commerce, new technologies or luxury goods industries. Mathilde’s dual French-American education enables her to represent Anglo-Saxon companies in a global environment, thanks to a pragmatic approach focused on the economic stakes at hand and on solutions that fit into the social strategy of the company. Her excellent knowledge of the German language and German culture also leads her to successfully deal with French-German cross-border practice in Paris and New York. Mathilde is a recognized labour and employment law specialist and regularly speaks at conferences hosted by the American Bar Association, the International Bar Association and the Canadian Bar Association. Mathilde is the author or co-author of numerous publications, including “International Labor and Employment Laws” and “Social Networking”, published by the Labor and Employment Law Section of the American Bar Association.<nl/>Mathilde is fluent in French, English and German with some knowledge of Italian. Mathilde is recommended by her peers as:”an excellent lawyer, who is exceedingly well known and incredibly active in the market, particularly on an international level.” (Who’s Who Legal)<nl/>Mathilde regularly publishes articles in English for the American Bar Association on various topics related to labor law issues :<nl/><square>Gender</square> discrimination in France<nl/><square>Data</square> protection and privacy in the workplace<nl/><square>Edde Summer</square><nl/><square>Whistleblowing</square><nl/><square>2013 Social Media France</square><nl/><square>New law</square> eases redeployement obligations in France<nl/><square>French Workscouncils</square> and the reorganization of businesses<nl/><square>France social</square> networking and the Global Workforce<nl/><square>An Innangard Report</square> on Sexual Harassment in Key Jurisdictions (Chapter 'France')<nl/><square>Labor and Employment</square> Law newsletter winter 2019<nl/><square>Women and the Glass</square> Ceiling in France<nl/><square>Worker Misclassification:</square> An Innangard Report on Employee Status and Consequences of Worker Misclassification in Key Jurisdictions (Chapter 'France')

francoisPenillard.title: Lawyer (2019)
francoisPenillard.name: François PENILLARD
francoisPenillard.intro: François practices corporate law (day-to-day and complex transactions), mergers and acquisitions, commercial litigation, and criminal business law. He advises companies, executives, and shareholders on their most strategic issues, including transaction structuring, governance, crisis management, complex litigation, and criminal liability of economic actors.<nl/>After gaining international experience, François joined Weil & Associés in 2019 and was appointed partner in 2025. His dual academic background—a Master's degree and LL.M. in business law—enables him to work comfortably in multicultural and transnational environments.<nl/>Trilingual (French, English, German) and a member of several international legal networks, his dual training, combined with his daily international practice, makes him a privileged contact for cross-border groups, particularly in sensitive or high-stakes contexts.<nl/>Driven by a rigorous and committed approach, François cultivates a vision of law as a tool for anticipation, power, and clarity in a constantly changing world. He is closely interested in economic, geopolitical, and technological changes—particularly artificial intelligence and its legal implications.

whoWeAre.pageDescriptionSEO: Explore Weil & Associés: our law firm specializes in legal advice, committed to providing innovative and tailored solutions for every client. Meet our team and discover our unique approach.
whoWeAre.firmPresentation: Founded in 1974, <blue>Weil & Associés</blue> has rapidly earned a reputation for excellence in corporate law. <nl/>At the heart of our mission: cutting-edge <blue>legal expertise</blue> that fosters innovation and growth for our clients, whether they are multinational companies or SMEs. <nl/>Our versatile team is particularly <blue>renowned for its responsiveness and attention to detail</blue>, ensuring effective representation before courts and arbitral institutions.
whoWeAre.NOUS SOMMES DEDIES A VOTRE SUCCES: WE ARE DEDICATED TO YOUR SUCCESS
whoWeAre.nous-sommes-dedies-a-votre-succes-descri: Since its establishment in 1974 Weil & Associés is a law firm dedicated to the service of international companies.<nl/>Our firm is devoted to assist companies, international or small and medium-sized, in their commercial or industrial activities in France or abroad through proactive legal advice as well as by the defence of our clients before courts and arbitral tribunals.
whoWeAre.nous-sommes-internationnaux-description: Business relationships of German and English speaking countries have always been a major part of our activity. Therefore, our firm has lawyers admitted at bars in France, Germany and the USA at the same time.<nl/>Our involvement in the advice to and representation of international clients implies that all lawyers write and speak fluently German, French and English.<nl/>In the course of time, our activity conducted us to broaden our horizon and to represent companies from countries such as Japan, Korea and China.
whoWeAre.plus-loin-plus-intelligent-plus-rapide-d: Even though all lawyers are specialised, we believe in an enrichment of the juristic creativity by a large field of experience in legal advice and defence.
whoWeAre.votre-confiance-nous-honore-description: Our work is based on mutual trust with each and every client, international companies as well as small and medium-sized enterprises.<nl/>Each client’s activity, products and professional environment are carefully taken into consideration as our goal is to provide our client with tailor made solutions which take due account of the client’s specific business interests.<nl/>Thanks to the small size of our firm, we compose a team of dynamic lawyers who are acquainted to respond rapidly and with flexibility to the client’s needs.<nl/>We shall never forget that the essence of our work, be it legal advice or advocacy, is to achieve an economically valuable result for our client.

privacyPolicy.data-processing-types:
6.2 Type, processing and purpose of data collected


Weil & Associés may process all or part of the following data, some of which are essential for the proper functioning of the online services offered on the site www.weil-paris.fr:
  • Connection, navigation and site use data - Processing: enable and/or improve navigation on the site, establish audience statistics, measure the return on investment of acquisition marketing campaigns.
  • Identity and/or private data (title, first and last name, age, weight, description of a situation or personal/professional problem) - Treatment: answer a question, provide a quote, make an appointment online, be called back urgently, etc.
  • Technical data on the computer equipment used for navigation, the IP address, the identifier and password (hash) for connection to a secure space - Processing: secure communications with or from the site, prevent and fight against computer fraud (
  • Contact data such as landline and/or mobile telephone number, email address - Processing: carry out loyalty marketing campaigns by email or SMS.
  • Geographic data postal address type - Processing: display a position, define an intervention zone or calculate a route between two locations.
  • Voice data (audio recordings) - Processing: save a message via an automatic responder in the event of the absence or unavailability of a telephone line or switchboard, in order to be called back by the person concerned.
  • Financial datas in relation to quotes, orders and sales made via the site - Processing: manage and ensure the traceability of services ordered by Users.
All data is kept for a maximum period of 12 months after collection or the end of the contractual relationship between the User and the Publisher.
privacyPolicy.access-rectification-opposition-rights:
6.3 RIGHT OF ACCESS, RECTIFICATION AND OPPOSITION


In accordance with current European regulations, Users of the site www.weil-paris.fr have the following rights:
  • Right of access (article 15 GDPR) and rectification (article 16 GDPR), updating, completeness of User data, right to block or erase User data of a personal nature (article 17 GDPR), when they are inaccurate, incomplete,
  • Right to withdraw consent at any time (article 13-2c GDPR)
  • Right to limit the processing of User data (article 18 GDPR)
  • Right to object to the processing of User data (article 21 GDPR)
  • Right to data portability that Users have provided, when these data are subject to automated processing based on their consent or on a contract (article 20 GDPR)
  • Right to define the fate of User data after their death and to choose to whom the Publisher must communicate (or not) its data to a third party that it has previously designated
As soon as the Publisher becomes aware of the death of a User and in the absence of instructions from him, he undertakes to destroy his data, unless their conservation proves necessary for evidentiary purposes or to meet an obligation.

If the User wishes to know how the Publisher uses its Personal data, request to rectify them or object to their processing, he can contact in writing the Data Protection Officer (DPO), to the following address :
Weil & Associés - DPO - [ID] 58 avenue Marceau, 75008 Paris

In his letter, the User must indicate the Personal data that he wishes to correct, update or delete, by identifying himself precisely with a copy of an identity document (identity card or passport). Personal data will be subject to the obligations imposed by law, in particular with regard to the conservation or archiving of documents. CNIL (https://www.cnil.fr/fr/plaintes).

cookiesPolicy.whatAreCookies:
1 What are cookies?


According to the definition given by the CNIL: “a “cookie” is a series of information, generally small and identified by a name, which can be transmitted to your browser by a website to which you connect.
Your web browser will store it for a certain period of time, and send it back to the web server each time you reconnect.

Cookies have multiple uses: they allow you to save your browsing preferences, navigate easily from one page to another, save your connection ID, etc.

Cookies can be categorized based on their purpose:

Cookies necessary for the service: these are cookies essential for the operation of our service, in particular with regard to sending and receiving information via the various contact forms present on the site.

Anonymous visit statistics cookies: these are cookies which make it possible to collect in an aggregated, and therefore anonymous, manner information concerning user navigation.

Third-party analysis cookies: these cookies allow our site to record your browsing preferences and therefore improve your user experience.

Advertising cookies: these are cookies that allow us to show you the advertisements most suited to your interests.
